description: Turn user input that reaches a shell into arbitrary OS command execution. Load when a parameter feeds a system call — ping/nslookup/host tools, file conversion (ImageMagick, ffmpeg), archive/ export, PDF/thumbnail generation, filename handling, or any "network tools" feature. Signals: output that looks like command output, a value echoed into a system utility, blind time/OOB behaviour.
